result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: the cap is mutual and set at the greater of paid/payable 12-month hosting and support fees or USD 1 million; indirect/consequential damages are mutually excluded; all required preferred carve-outs are uncapped; and Client fee obligations are outside the cap. Unrelated warranty language is preserved. It is not strictly minimal because it also excludes incidental damages and reorders the unchanged warranty disclaimer. Drafting is generally professional, but the 12-month lookback is not expressly tied to the claim, and the Excluded Claims definition is syntactically awkward as to indemnification obligations, gross negligence, and the other listed matters.
